crossRefs.note: The Horites also lived in Seir in the past, but the children of Esau succeeded them. They destroyed them from before…
as he did for the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they…
The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
